title: Breaking Resume Myths
description:
Breaking resume myths based on science

 Can your resume be longer than a page? - Yes!
 Should a resume only be in Word format? - No!
 Do you need a summary? - No, but it's nice to have!
 Is there a certain number of bullet points you need to have? - No, it depends on the job!
 Do you need to have a cover letter? - No, but it's nice to have!

Learn WHY & see what tool Maddie uses for her resume!

*SPOILER ALERT* She uses Teal 

#resumehelp #resumeadvice #resumetips
